items.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal Interview, 1962-05-24
items.q: So we were intimate. We were close friends.

ctx.x: They said what kind of music did you all play? You know, you used to play music. She played piano.

Yeah, I played piano. Oh, well, Claude Williams. Didn't you ask me about Claude Williams? Yeah. Well, Claude Williams, you know, he originated from that. He was born in Donisonville. And his son is playing now, I think, in Baton Rouge. And he has a daughter who is a nun. I think she's still a nun. And he was my mother's groomsman when she got married. So we were intimate. We were close friends. His daughter is here in the world?
I think she's in the country on all these streets. The Holy Family is going.
